# VigyanLLM

> VigyanLLM is an automated bioinformatics platform for primer design, BLAST, molecular docking, multiple sequence alignment, and sequence analysis. Free tools that run in your browser, built for researchers in India and worldwide.

VigyanLLM Private Limited is a DPIIT-recognised Indian company headquartered in New Delhi, Delhi, India, operating under the brand VigyanLLM (vigyanllm.in).

## Tools

- [Primer Design](https://www.vigyanllm.in/primer): Design and specificity-check PCR primers with a 24-step validated pipeline
- [BLAST](https://www.vigyanllm.in/blast): Nucleotide and protein similarity search with specificity filtering
- [Molecular Docking](https://www.vigyanllm.in/docking): Dock ligands to protein targets in the browser
- [Multiple Sequence Alignment](https://www.vigyanllm.in/msa): Align sequences with homology and conservation analysis
- [Tm Calculator](https://www.vigyanllm.in/tm-calculator): Primer melting temperature under your salt conditions
- [GC Content Calculator](https://www.vigyanllm.in/gc-calculator): GC percentage and molecular weight for any sequence

## Company

- [About](https://www.vigyanllm.in/about): Headquarters — New Delhi, Delhi, India; DPIIT-recognised; Delhi GST

- [Pricing](https://www.vigyanllm.in/pricing): Free, Pro, Lab, and Enterprise plans with INR pricing
- [Cite VigyanLLM](https://www.vigyanllm.in/cite-vigyanllm): Citation formats for papers and reports
